Subject: Google verification, due Oct 30

Hi Dr. Patel,

The calendar and contacts sync is working now. One thing before the end of the month: Google requires a verification review for apps that touch Gmail and Calendar data, and it's $540 a year. It has to be done by Oct 30, or your staff will see an unverified app warning.

I'd suggest we go ahead and pay it. We'll handle the payment and paperwork, so you don't have to do anything. Please feel free to reply with a yes and we'll start right away.

Best,
